name: keras_se_gate
title: Squeeze-and-excite Keras classifier on a rebinding-style tf.data pipeline
origin: written from the Sprint-4 review's own false-positive repros (ANA7-709-NOT-OUTPUT, ANA9-121-TAKE-PEEK, FW-REBIND-CHAIN-SILENT)
tunedWhy: the MLV709 and MLV121 guards were developed against exactly these shapes, so its zero-forbidden result is a regression guard and not an unseen measurement. Growing the genuinely unseen half of the corpus still needs programs nobody on this project wrote, which docs/ACCURACY.md names as the cheapest recall work on the board.
note: No `graph` block: this program was added for its findings, and claiming a hand-drawn diagram for it would move the graph-fidelity ratchet on evidence nobody drew.

expected.defect: the validation half is taken and the training half skipped off a dataset shuffled with reshuffle_each_iteration left at its default
expected.why: tf.data re-draws both halves every epoch, so by the second pass every validation row has been trained on. The whole pipeline is written `ds = ds.<op>(...)`, the style the official tf.data guide uses: before FW-REBIND the receiver on the right-hand side resolved to the store the same statement was about to write, so this chain minted 2 nodes, 0 edges and no diagnostic, and the identical program with distinct names fired.

forbidden.why: the two `Dense(channels, activation="sigmoid")` calls are squeeze-and-excite channel gates multiplied back into the feature map, and the model's actual output layer is linear - which is what BinaryCrossentropy(from_logits=True) asks for. Pairing an activation literal with a from_logits loss by family alone reported the gate as an output activation at severity high, confidence 0.95.
keras.utils.set_random_seed(7) seeds TensorFlow, NumPy and Python at line 17
build_model() calls model.compile() before returning, so fit() has an optimizer and a loss
there is no sklearn or torch splitter in this project; take/skip is a tf.data subset, not a SPLIT-role call
val_ds is never shuffled - the shuffle is upstream of the split, which is the planted defect, not a second one at the evaluation loader
